question: Which one of the following software applications is NOT a part of Microsoft Office?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Acrobat Reader**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Acrobat Reader** is not a part of Microsoft Office suite.
 
• Microsoft Office includes applications such as **Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and others** primarily used for productivity tasks.
 
• **Acrobat Reader** is a product of **Adobe Systems** and is used for viewing, printing, and annotating PDF documents.
 
• Microsoft Office applications are designed to work seamlessly together, whereas **Acrobat Reader** is a standalone application for PDF files.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Microsoft Word** is a word processing application used for creating and editing documents.
 
• **Microsoft PowerPoint** is a presentation program used for creating slideshows.
 
• **Microsoft Excel** is a spreadsheet application used for data analysis and visualization.
 
• The **Microsoft Office suite** has been a leading productivity software package for decades.
 
• **Adobe Acrobat Reader** is frequently used in conjunction with office software but is not a component of the Microsoft Office suite.
